page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E5.Flex.64-1024 is a high-capacity virtual machine configuration within the Standard family. Powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9J14 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz, the instance delivers 64 physical cores and 128 virtual CPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. Symmetrical multi-threading allocates two threads per physical core, ensuring consistent computational execution across all virtual cores.

The hardware configuration pairs 128 vCPUs with 1024 GB of system memory, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. This high memory density classifies the configuration effectively as a memory-optimized compute environment. The instance features no integrated local storage or hardware GPU acceleration, requiring cloud administrators to provision network-attached block volumes for operating systems, application binaries, and persistent datasets. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is included by default for network routing and ingress management.

Cost efficiency for VM.Standard.E5.Flex.64-1024 is driven by resource consolidation and high memory-per-core scalability. By offering 1 TB of dedicated RAM without requiring bare-metal host leasing, the instance minimizes unused overhead when hosting heavy multithreaded systems. The principal architectural tradeoff centers on reliance on network storage for primary storage input and output throughput, as the node does not bundle low-latency local NVMe drives.

This server instance is positioned for memory-intensive workloads that demand extensive CPU thread parallelism. Primary deployment targets include large in-memory databases such as Redis and SAP HANA, distributed data processing clusters, memory-heavy enterprise analytics engines, high-concurrency Java application runtimes, and large-scale transactional relational database workloads.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E5.Flex.64-1024 is an enterprise virtual server powered by AMD EPYC 9J14 processors on the x86_64 architecture. The instance allocates 64 physical cores, yielding 128 dedicated virtual CPUs clocked at 2.3 GHz with simultaneous multithreading enabled. Equipped with 1024 GB of system memory, it establishes an elevated 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio tailored for large memory footprints. No local disk storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with the instance, necessitating external network-attached block storage for data persistence and operating files. The instance includes a single complimentary public IPv4 address. Providing a cost-efficient balance of compute scale and memory density within a flexible virtualization layer, VM.Standard.E5.Flex.64-1024 is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, data analytics, enterprise cache tiers, distributed ETL operations, and heavy computational memory-resident transactional systems.
